gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.175: Caravan guards carry musketoons that fire a cannonball. A slow load, a heavy hit, and the only way to own one is to take it from a guard who has fallen.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.176: Realms that follow The Truth or the Crowned Sun dress their guards in Templar plate, and their armourers sell it, with the schematic, only to the faithful.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.177: Wear a whole set and it works together: the Ranger's harness loads guns quicker, Primalist wrappings quicken your feet, a Sanguine coat makes healing stronger.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.178: Armour tires you. Plate wears your feathers down fastest when you sprint, swing and take blows, and when they run out the next hit can knock the weapon from your hand.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.179: Every weapon has its distance. Daggers want you close, spears want you at the end of their reach; mail turns a cut, a thrust finds its gaps, and a mace crushes plate.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.180: A Forge Hammer fights like a heavy sword, breaks stone like a pick and works the Smithing Anvil like a smith's hammer.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.181: Every Flame Avatar in a Nether camp follows a different calling. Their tinkerer carries the fire cannon, which burns blaze rods and powder instead of shot.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.182: Armour goes on in layers. Open the Harness tab in your inventory for padding and mail under the cuirass, spaulders, limb plate, a cloak, a hood and a crest.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.183: A lowered visor narrows your sight to a slit but turns more blows from your face. The Home key raises or lowers it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.184: A realm arms its gunners by its purse: handgonnes when it is poor, arquebuses when it prospers, muskets when it is rich. A wet match won't fire.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.185: Take an old piece apart at the Drafting Table, with paper in your pack, to learn how it was made. Brush old ruins and scuffed battlefields for worn armour worth the trouble.
